svg.title: Reading Kern Fig. 24: j_H at Re = 3.04×10⁴
svg.text: Reading Kern Fig. 24: j_H at Re = 3.04×10⁴
Tube-side heat-transfer curve, redrawn: laminar 1.86 (Re D/L)^1/3, turbulent 0.027 Re^0.8
Mark Re = 3.04×10⁴ on the Reynolds-number axis (L/D = 310).
Go straight up to the L/D = 310 curve (here all L/D curves have merged into the turbulent line).
Go across to the j_H axis on the left.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
